protocol.objective: Separate internal slew and latch operating-margin limitations from device-size effects; compare CMOS blocks at the same PDK,supply,frequency,load and integration band.
protocol.scope: Ideal-drive CMOS unit results do not include actual LC level conversion and cannot be called a fullPLL result. Internal probes retain physical chain. User100fs experience is a research benchmark, not a change to REQ06.
protocol.conditions: TT27,1.2V,out984MHz,10fF,10kHz–492MHz. PSS1ps/63 to0.5ps/127 before promotion. CMOS RF clock source initially ideal10ps/3.936GHz; realRF interface remains to be measured.
protocol.criteria: Frequency within0.1%, per-cycle error<2%,out<.2V and>1V; PSS endpoint<1mV and fundamental984MHz; numerical integration/Jee agreement<1.5%; refinement<1% RMS and<.1dB maximum PSD difference.
